jordan: Onboarding kairos-7b (Mistral checkpoint converted to Llama-like layout). After int4 quant we see a summarization ROUGE-L drop ~6 pts vs float32. Anyone seen rotary/vocab or kvcache alignment causing quality regressions?
sasha: Hmm yep. We've seen rotary scale/headwise mismatch when converting Mistral->Llama. Also check tokenizer normalization (NFKC vs NFC) and any off-by-one vocab offsets. Can you paste a short repro? :mag:
jordan: Quick repro numbers and eval snippet: 
```
# eval command
python eval_summarize.py --model kairos-7b --quant int4 --batch 32 --metric rouge
# results
float32 (greedy) ROUGE-L: 46.2
int4 (load_quant) ROUGE-L: 40.1
# sample mismatch (reference / hyp)
ref: The committee approved the measure.
hyp: The committee has approved the measures.
```
Ideas: rotary params, kvcache alignment, or token id shifts.
derek: Can you paste the model config (head/ d_head) and the rotary args? We had a case where Mistral exported per-head rotary rescale and our loader applied a global scale which wrecked attention geometry. Also check whether the converter swapped q/k order.
jordan: Config excerpt: 
```
n_head: 32
d_head: 64
rotary: { base: 10000, rescale: true, per_head: true }
qkv_order: "qkv"
```
Converter used earlier assumed `per_head: false` so it applied a scalar rescale.
nana: Try two quick fixes: 1) force per-head rotary passthrough in the converter (don't collapse scales), 2) verify vocab mapping: some Mistral checkpoints use a sentinel token at idx 1 while our tokenizer expects bos=1 -> off-by-one. Commands: 
```
python convert_checkpoint.py --src mistral --tgt llama --fix-rotary --preserve-per-head
python convert_checkpoint.py --src mistral --tgt llama --patch-vocab-offsets
```
jordan: Kicked off re-conversion with `--fix-rotary --patch-vocab-offsets`, queued eval. I'll post logs. Thanks. :pray:
eval-bot: queued job 4321 for kairos-7b int4 re-conversion; est 12m
(12m later)
jordan: Quick update: reconversion + loader change -> int4 ROUGE-L: 45.3 (was 40.1). Hallucination rate on our summarization eval down ~18%. So two factors: collapsed rotary rescale during conversion, and a single-token vocab sentinel offset that shifted a few prompts and increased repetition.
sasha: Nice! That delta strongly suggests geometric attention mismatch is the bigger offender, vocab offset just aggravated prompt framing. Can you open a PR with the converter flag and add a small unit test comparing float32 vs int4 perplexity on 50 samples?
jordan: Yup will open PR and add a smoke test (50 samples, ensure ROUGE-L delta <= 2.5 between float32 and int4 on our quickly curated set). Also logging the exact commands we used for the run in the PR description. :tada:
